comparisons.reason: Different constructs on the same source. Feature 0 requires a specific identifiable real-world example (event, person, case, study, etc.), whether or not it contains numbers. Feature 1 requires specific numerical data or statistics, and explicitly excludes non-quantitative examples. A named case with no figures scores 1 on 0 and 0 on 1. A statistic with no named case can score the reverse.
